def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Untrusted plugin: reads path and also tries notes/../secret.txt, joined by "|"."""
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Run plugin(path) with fs confined to the directory notes.

    path is relative to notes. Anything the plugin reads outside notes,
    including the literal "notes/../secret.txt", fails and becomes "".
    """
    post "|" in out
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path)
